38694347.title: Everyone_Hates_Elon
38694347.extract:
Lead section:
Elon Musk, the businessman and entrepreneur behind Tesla and SpaceX, has gained significant attention and notoriety in recent years. A recent survey revealed that over half of U.S. adults hold an unfavorable view of him, making him the least popular public figure in the country. His business ventures, controversies, and personal behavior have shaped public perception.

Main sections:
1. Business Ventures
2. Controversies
3. Personal Behavior
